verdict.rationale: The firm's contact page lists its own offices outside India: "cam singapore Pte Ltd" in Singapore and "cam middle east" at Abu Dhabi Global Market, alongside six Indian cities and GIFT City. That meets the core claim of stated presence in multiple countries. Its funds practice also describes acting as lead counsel for cross-border funds. Missing for 10: any detail on what those foreign offices practise or which local-law qualifications they hold, coverage beyond India/Singapore/UAE (e.g., US/UK/EU), and independent corroboration of the overseas offices' capabilities.
